verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI palette lets users summarize meeting notes, list action items, and answer free-form prompts within notes, which is a lightweight in-app AI assistant, but it's limited to text generation/summarization on note content rather than true task delegation (e.g., taking multi-step actions, executing external tasks, or autonomous agentic behavior). missing for 10: evidence of the assistant performing multi-step task delegation or autonomous actions beyond text generation/chat, independent hands-on validation of the AI palette's capabilities.
